actual_pr.body:
A static finite controller now approximates a supplied computable unitary on the original interacting source chain, including passive references. The construction uses supplied identical chains, clock-conditioned crossed bonds and finite-range interactions of arity at most six. It gives a positive full-space Hamiltonian, explicit exponential resource bounds, precision estimates and actual-energy accounting. Native preparation, stopping and terminal readout/reset remain open.

The note preserves all three complete reviewed proof bodies, the fuel-width counterexample and its correction. Broad copy-mismatch/nonunitary-block estimates and the narrower exact-copy/unitary-block fuel ledger have separate hypotheses. Supplied-copy partial swaps, Hamiltonian computation and perfect transfer are attributed prior machinery. The history application is separate.

Root review and a separate source-exposed mathematical review cover the conditional argument. Historical finite controls retain their actual scope; the large-M calculation is a channel superoperator, not a full apparatus simulation or diamond-norm certificate. Source integration verified all 118 staged paths, syntax, metadata, links, vocabulary, four integrity controls, the identity-only cache and preservation of existing graph objects. The graph adds one root and no scientific dependency edges; PR #9531 supplies Git ancestry only.

Those integration checks execute zero mathematical predicates. The focused existing-ledger checker returned an empty checked list and proves no scientific claim. Complete available raw streams and receipts are preserved. Combined current-main validation, strict audit lint and independent retained audit remain later obligations; this PR does not confer retained status.
actual_pr.title: Prove conditional autonomous control of an interacting source
